verdict.rationale: Vue explicitly markets itself as 'incrementally adoptable' (vue-docs-2) and community evidence confirms the classic script-tag drop-in workflow with no build tooling required (vue-comm-7), which is exactly the use case of embedding Vue into an existing server-rendered page for isolated interactive widgets. Missing for 10: first-party docs/tutorial specifically demonstrating mounting Vue on a subset of an existing HTML page, and independent hands-on write-ups of migrating a legacy server-rendered app incrementally.
